description: As the team on a booking (bookingId): a proposal to accept one of the client's offered slots (slotId). Accepting charges €30 from each side; if the client does not show, the team's €30 becomes a credit; if the team does not show, its €30 is not returned. Stores a proposal only. Nothing happens until the person confirms it on welance.com/directory; the result includes the review link.

summary.description: One sentence, in the conversation language, saying what happens on confirm.
